purpose: Conservative first-party/government and third-party freight source discovery to guide future independently approved acquisition. No source content fetched into the product.
selection_policy: Only explicitly sourced public metadata; published web/GitHub visibility is not a reuse license.

sources.name: 2022 Commodity Flow Survey Public Use Microdata Sample
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau / Bureau of Transportation Statistics
sources.file_size_display: 680 MB, as advertised on source page
sources.source_basis: Census publishes 2022 PUMS CSV and documentation and describes confidentiality-protected public-use data. This is sampled shipment-characteristic microdata, not paid carrier freight invoices.
sources.limitations: Sampling/weighting and confidentiality treatment require the official users guide. Cannot identify carrier invoice errors, contracted rates, refunds, recoverable overcharges, buyer willingness or actual RETALLY audit accuracy.
sources.next_action: Review published PUMS data dictionary, user guide, download and reuse terms and permitted sampling before a scoped, checksum-recorded import.

sources.name: Freight Analysis Framework FAF6.0 2022 Regional Database
sources.file_size_display: 20 MB regional CSV, as advertised on source page
sources.source_basis: FAF6.0 downloadable regional database estimates tonnage and value by origin-destination pair, commodity and mode for the 2022 benchmark.
sources.limitations: Modelled freight flows in thousands of tons and millions of constant 2022 dollars are not actual accounts, carrier invoices, freight audit market revenue or ground-truth overcharges.
sources.next_action: Review FAF6 documentation and source-data terms; obtain bounded column-level sample only after a human-governed import approval.

sources.name: Census Commodity Flow Survey 2022 API geographic tables
sources.source_basis: Census documents the 2022 CFS geographic, temperature, exports and hazardous-material tables and API key requirement.
sources.limitations: API tabulations do not expose actual freight bills, negotiated tariffs, invoice errors, fee cash or approved claims. No API request or credential use was performed.
sources.next_action: Confirm Census API rate/attribution rules and field definitions; request no API key or personal data during this research-only phase.

sources.name: 2022 Commodity Flow Survey final published tables
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau / Bureau of Transportation Statistics
sources.file_size_display: Multiple tables; no local download performed
sources.source_basis: Census provides published 2022 CFS tables and suggested source attribution.
sources.limitations: Official survey estimates are not a count of audited freight bills, company TAM, invoice error prevalence or cash recovered. Do not double count CFS with derivative FAF data.
sources.next_action: Review table universe, suppression, sample uncertainty, duplicate overlap and citation requirements before market modelling.

sources.name: EdiFabric public X12 210 freight invoice illustration

sources.limitations: A public example is not independently identified as a real invoice, correctness oracle, tested RETALLY result or reusable dataset. Website content ownership and X12 standard rights require review.
sources.next_action: Request/review explicit permission and permitted parsing/test uses. Do not copy sample payload into RETALLY repository without rights check.
